actions.label: Provide food rations to guards and their families
Allow FWB and its chosen assistants to manage food disbursement directly
Secure Ministry/SML funding for generator, guard pay and infrastructure
Have guard structures organize and implement distribution
Allow FWB staff unescorted movement inside the camp
Permit FWB nutritional assessments in the camp
Coordinate public communications and avoid publicity
Crack down on food ration trading in the camp
Source food and services from host-town suppliers
Give guards/militia an agreed role in distribution
Commit to sustained, scheduled food deliveries to the camp
Distribute food impartially to all registered refugees

goals.label: The camp receives sustained, ongoing food aid
FWB and outside staff move unescorted inside the camp
Camp generator and fuel keep running
Commander controls the public narrative about the camp
Commander's authority and appearance of strength
FWB controls food distribution independently of guard structures
FWB's neutrality and impartiality
Food aid is diverted to guards, militia or commander
Food is distributed fairly without discrimination
Government funding for guard pay and camp infrastructure
Guards and militia control food distribution
Guards and their families are fed and paid
Host town economy and goodwill protected, local actors prioritized
Hostile actors exploit outsider access
Refugees face abuse or collective punishment by guards
Refugees receive adequate food aid
Refugees remain contained in the camp
Refugees' nutritional needs are known and documented
Safety of FWB staff in the camp
Commander's personal safety
Local assistants chosen by FWB help with distribution
Senior Militia Leader's trust in the commander

redLines.label: Prioritize local hires as distribution assistants
redLines.quote: If FWB hires local independent laborers for the food distribution, you cannot trust those people not to stir unrest and even potentially support hidden terrorists by sharing items or information.

redLines.label: Hire local host-town assistants for distribution
redLines.quote: If FWB hires local independent laborers for the food distribution, you cannot trust those people not to stir unrest and even potentially support hidden terrorists by sharing items or information.

redLines.label: Provide food rations to guards and their families
redLines.quote: If they see the refugees eating better than they are, they may well rebel, and it may be your head.

assumptions: Commitments are binding and additive.
Goals and goal-action links were each extracted 3 times by a model; only those found in a majority of runs are kept.
Actions are chosen to bring about as much goal value as possible, within the solver's size limit.
Our values are the median of stances elicited from our role card.
The opponent column is the expected value of an elicited stance distribution (shared documents only); each opponent reading is one draw from it, independently per goal.
Stance labels map to numbers by a fixed scale (game.stance_values), not a measured utility.

Red lines and must-haves come from our role card, each with a verbatim quote. No plan may include a red-line action, leave out a must-have, or pass through a state worth less to us than our BATNA (the bottom line).
